name: liquidity-heatmap
title: Liquidity Heatmap
description: Resting liquidity by price level over time as a grid of cells whose strength follows the size, with a current-price row and an arrow-key readout.

props.name: cells
props.description: Liquidity per cell, cells[row][column]. Row 0 is the highest price, column 0 the oldest time.

props.name: rowLabels
props.description: One label per row, top to bottom.

props.name: columnLabels
props.description: One label per column, left to right.

props.name: markerRow
props.description: Row index of the current price; its row gets a marker.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats values in the readout (compact by default).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
